rules.title: Pass by reference or view
rules.what: Pass non-trivial objects by const&, move to transfer ownership, and read through std::string_view/std::span instead of copying.
rules.why: Passing a string or vector by value copies its entire content on every call.
rules.how: void f(const std::string& s) or f(std::string_view s); std::move for sinks.

patterns.note: Container or string parameter by value; fine only for sink parameters that are moved.

verify.how: No by-value container or string parameter that is not a deliberate sink.

rules.title: Reserve from known bounds, find with hashes
rules.what: reserve() containers when the size is known, emplace instead of pushing temporaries, and use unordered_map/set instead of repeated std::find on large vectors.
rules.why: A growing vector copies its content at every reallocation; repeated linear search makes the work quadratic.
rules.how: v.reserve(n); v.emplace_back(args...); build an unordered_set once before the loop.

patterns.note: std::find inside a loop; candidate for a hash lookup.

verify.how: Allocation profile or benchmark on representative volume for performance-motivated changes.

rules.title: unique_ptr by default, RAII throughout
rules.what: Use std::unique_ptr unless ownership is genuinely shared; manage every resource with RAII.
rules.why: shared_ptr pays an atomic reference count on every copy, usually for ownership that is unique.
rules.how: std::make_unique; shared_ptr only with a documented shared owner; no raw owning new/delete.

patterns.note: Shared ownership; check that unique ownership would not do.

verify.how: Each shared_ptr has a documented shared owner.

rules.title: Stream large files, bound threads
rules.what: Read large files in blocks rather than whole into a string; bound thread pools and futures and make sure no task survives shutdown.
rules.why: Whole-file reads cost memory proportional to size; unbounded threads and detached tasks keep cores and memory busy after the work is gone.
rules.how: std::ifstream with a fixed buffer; a fixed-size pool; std::jthread with stop_token; join on shutdown.

patterns.note: Detached thread: no join, no bound, nothing waits for it.

verify.how: Shutdown test asserts all workers joined; memory flat on a large input.
